name: resume-portfolio-workflow
description: A staged workflow for verified resume content and expressive React + Vite portfolio websites.

interface.shortDescription: Verified resume content to expressive portfolio site
interface.longDescription: Use resume-portfolio-workflow to route requests, resume-content-intelligence to verify and approve content, and build-resume-portfolio-site to design, audit, and motion-harden a React + Vite portfolio.
defaultPrompt: Turn my resume into a verified portfolio website
Build a React portfolio from my approved content
Audit and improve my portfolio's visual direction
